🔥 बॉलीवुड में मचने वाला है बड़ा धमाल, क्योंकि कार्तिक और कबीर की जोड़ी फिर आ रही है! 🎬

कार्तिक आर्यन और डायरेक्टर कबीर खान एक बार फिर साथ आ रहे हैं अपनी नई फिल्म Ladaku के साथ। 🤩
Birla Studios के ऐलान के मुताबिक, ये फिल्म 18 June 2027 को दुनियाभर के सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगी। 📅
ये फिल्म ambition, determination और hope पर आधारित है, जो असली जिंदगी की घटनाओं से प्रेरित है। ✨
खास बात ये है कि इस फिल्म से कार्तिक आर्यन बतौर प्रोड्यूसर Dopamine Studios के जरिए अपना प्रोडक्शन डेब्यू कर रहे हैं। 👏
Birla Studios, Kabir Khan Entertainment और Dopamine Studios मिलकर इस फिल्म को प्रोड्यूस कर रहे हैं। 🤝
इससे पहले ये जोड़ी Chandu Champion में साथ काम कर चुकी है, जिसे काफी तारीफ मिली थी। 🏆
यह एक इमोशनल और फैमिली-ओरिएंटेड एंटरटेनर फिल्म होगी, जिसे लेकर फैंस में अभी से काफी एक्साइटमेंट है। 🍿

क्या आप कार्तिक और कबीर की इस नई फिल्म Ladaku के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Kartik Aaryan and Kabir Khan reunite for inspirational real-life story Ladaku, set to release on June 18, 2027
ctx.summary: Birla Studios has announced June 18, 2027, as the worldwide theatrical release date of Ladaku, starring Kartik Aaryan and directed by Kabir Khan. The film brings together Kartik and Kabir, who previously collaborated on Chandu Champion, for another project centred on an inspiring story. The announcement was made by Birla Studios today. The film marks a collaboration between the National Award-winning team of Kartik Aaryan and Kabir Khan and Ananya Birla's Birla Studios. Titled Ladaku, the project is described as a story rooted in ambition, determination and hope, drawing inspiration from extraordinary real-life events. Ladaku is produced by Birla Studios and Kabir Khan Entertainment. It also marks Kartik Aaryan's debut as a producer under his banner, Dopamine Studios. With the actor stepping into production alongside his role in the film, the project brings together multiple production houses. The film also reunites Kartik and Kabir after Chandu Champion, which received appreciation and recognition during its awards run. Their return as a creative team has added to the interest surrounding the upcoming release. Kabir Khan has previously directed films such as Bajrangi Bhaijaan and 83, which explored stories of individuals and teams overcoming challenges through determination and resilience. Birla Studios has announced June 18, 2027, as the worldwide theatrical release date of Ladaku , starring Kartik Aaryan and directed by Kabir Khan. The film brings together Kartik and Kabir, who previously collaborated on Chandu Champion , for another project centred on an inspiring story. The announcement was made by Birla Studios today.
The film marks a collaboration between the National Award-winning team of Kartik Aaryan and Kabir Khan and Ananya Birla's Birla Studios. Titled Ladaku , the project is described as a story rooted in ambition, determination and hope, drawing inspiration from extraordinary real-life events.
Ladaku is produced by Birla Studios and Kabir Khan Entertainment. It also marks Kartik Aaryan's debut as a producer under his banner, Dopamine Studios. With the actor stepping into production alongside his role in the film, the project brings together multiple production houses.
The film also reunites Kartik and Kabir after Chandu Champion, which received appreciation and recognition during its awards run. Their return as a creative team has added to the interest surrounding the upcoming release.
Kabir Khan has previously directed films such as Bajrangi Bhaijaan and 83 , which explored stories of individuals and teams overcoming challenges through determination and resilience. With Ladaku , the filmmaker is set to explore another story that focuses on perseverance and the human spirit. The film is positioned as an emotional, family-oriented entertainer.
